<think>**Designing grouped default decode**

**Encoding explicit default logic**

</think>

{
  "candidate_rtl": "module mux_large (
    input [7:0] block_a, block_b, block_c, block_d, block_e,
    input [7:0] block_f, block_g, block_h, block_i, block_j,
    input [3:0] sel,
    output reg [7:0] block_out
);
    wire choose_a, choose_b, choose_c, choose_d, choose_e;
    wire choose_f, choose_g, choose_h, choose_i, choose_j;

    assign choose_a = (~sel[3] & ~sel[2] & ~sel[1] & ~sel[0])
                    | (sel[3] & (sel[2] | sel[1]));
    assign choose_b = ~sel[3] & ~sel[2] & ~sel[1] &  sel[0];
    assign choose_c = ~sel[3] & ~sel[2] &  sel[1] & ~sel[0];
    assign choose_d = ~sel[3] & ~sel[2] &  sel[1] &  sel[0];
    assign choose_e = ~sel[3] &  sel[2] & ~sel[1] & ~sel[0];
    assign choose_f = ~sel[3] &  sel[2] & ~sel[1] &  sel[0];
    assign choose_g = ~sel[3] &  sel[2] &  sel[1] & ~sel[0];
    assign choose_h = ~sel[3] &  sel[2] &  sel[1] &  sel[0];
    assign choose_i =  sel[3] & ~sel[2] & ~sel[1] & ~sel[0];
    assign choose_j =  sel[3] & ~sel[2] & ~sel[1] &  sel[0];

    always @* begin
        block_out = ({8{choose_a}} & block_a)
                  | ({8{choose_b}} & block_b)
                  | ({8{choose_c}} & block_c)
                  | ({8{choose_d}} & block_d)
                  | ({8{choose_e}} & block_e)
                  | ({8{choose_f}} & block_f)
                  | ({8{choose_g}} & block_g)
                  | ({8{choose_h}} & block_h)
                  | ({8{choose_i}} & block_i)
                  | ({8{choose_j}} & block_j);
    end
endmodule
",
  "bottleneck": "Select decoding, particularly default-to-block_a detection, followed by data gating and the ten-way output reduction. Shared select signals also have substantial fanout.",
  "rewrite": "Use explicit mutually exclusive selection enables and a parallel masked-OR datapath. Express the block_a enable directly as sel==0 or sel>=10, avoiding a default enable constructed by reducing and inverting the other selection decodes.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The simplified default decode may shorten the select-to-output critical path and exposes parallel data gating to ABC. No numerical improvement or optimality is claimed without running the specified mapping and timing flow.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Selection enables are shared across all eight output bits. The implementation retains ten data-gating terms per bit; mapped area, the 1006.089920um^2 cap, and electrical compliance require validation in the specified flow.",
  "functional_boundaries": "For every two-state input, selections 0 through 9 return block_a through block_j respectively, and selections 10 through 15 return block_a. Exactly one enable is asserted for each two-state sel. The module interface, unsigned widths, and combinational behavior are unchanged; no storage, latency, dependencies, or input assumptions are introduced. Four-state X/Z simulation equivalence is not claimed."
}
